onboarding.currencyHint: Default for new sessions; each session can use its own unit.
onboarding.playHint: Used to pre-fill your first session. You can change it every time.
onboarding.step3Intro: This is how a hand looks in your journal after review. Then try recording it yourself: it takes under a minute.
onboarding.sample_preflop: You open to 150, the BB calls.
onboarding.sample_flop: The BB checks, you bet 100, the BB calls.
onboarding.sample_river: The BB bets 300, you call. The BB shows K9: you lose.
onboarding.sample_range: The BB check-calls a dry flop, checks the turn, then leads big on the river: mostly a king or two pair, rarely a bluff.
onboarding.sample_line: Small c-bet and turn check back are fine. On the river, fold: ace-high beats only missed draws, and this board had almost none.
onboarding.sample_lesson:
1. A passive player who suddenly bets the river is usually strong: fold your bluff-catchers.
2. Ace-high is a bluff-catcher only when the opponent has missed draws.
onboarding.guide1: Pick your cards A♠ Q♠, then the board K♠ 7♦ 2♣ 9♥ 4♣.
onboarding.guide3: Actions street by street (buttons or shorthand), as in the sample.
onboarding.practiceAllRight: All correct. You are ready to record your own hands.
onboarding.practiceSomeWrong: Almost. Fix the parts marked ✗ and check again.
